methods.comment:
* Returns if a track in a {@link TrackGroup} is selected for playback. * *

Multiple tracks of a track group may be selected. This is common in adaptive streaming, * where multiple tracks of different quality are selected and the player switches between them * depending on the network and the {@link TrackSelectionParameters}. * *

While this class doesn't provide which selected track is currently playing, some player * implementations have ways of getting such information. For example ExoPlayer provides this * information in {@code ExoTrackSelection.getSelectedFormat}. * * @param trackIndex The index of the track in the {@link TrackGroup}. * @return true if the track is selected, false otherwise.
